'''Rayfel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] who was also a member of the [[Krannus's death cult|death cult]] led by [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]] that worshiped the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].

==Biography==
Around [[3641 BBY]], Commander Rayfel and his men held a group of scientists hostage when they encountered by the [[Hero of Tython]]. Informing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that Krannus had already left, Rayfel revealed that the scientists were not just hostages—when the Commander shot one of the scientists in the back of the head, Rayfel absorbed the man's life force in order to strengthen himself. Believing that he'd grow strong in defeating the Jedi, Rayfel charged and engaged the Knight with his increased power, forcing the Hero and company to draw their weapons and defeat the Imperials.
